summary: Apply non-strict this substitution: undefined/null become the global this value and primitives are boxed.

target.notes: OrdinaryCallBindThis converts the supplied this value according to non-strict thisMode. The host's global this value must be represented explicitly.

caveats: ECMAScript modules are strict, so this rule mainly applies to sloppy script/function code.
Browser WindowProxy/globalThis details can require host runtime support.

tests.name: null substituted
tests.expected_behavior: prints true in ordinary script host semantics
